selected_evidence.requirement: Only root and opsadmin can schedule cron jobs
selected_evidence.summary: The allowlist contains exactly root and opsadmin. Both allowed users successfully exercised crontab; antrieb was denied before and after reboot.
opsadmin exists as UID/GID 501 with /bin/bash and a locked password; the account persisted after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel retained

selected_evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot ID and healthy state were captured; reboot acknowledgement returned before disconnect; boot ID changed from 99bde3c2-c1f1-46b0-8000-000000000000 to 453830a0-18d3-402f-8000-000000000000; crond, accounts, allowlist, and enforcement recovered.
